Release v1.10.1 mistakenly did not update `ORIOLEDB_VERSION`. This release fixes it by setting new correct version to `ORIOLEDB_VERSION`.
- Moving a database to another tablespace on a physical standby now works correctly (73c99add)
- Fixed the default value of `orioledb.rewind_max_transactions` (ba092c6f)
Full Changelog: https://github.com/orioledb/orioledb/compare/v1.10.1...v1.10.2

- The empty orioledb_data/<dbOid> directory is removed after DROP DATABASE (01e9d660)
Starting with this release, OrioleDB uses `v<major>.<minor>.<patch>` release numbers (e.g. `v1.10.1`) instead of `betaN`. Release branches are named after the SQL version (`v1.10`), and only the most recent release branch is supported and receives backpatched fixes.

Added support for identity columns, which are the recommended alternative to `Serial` columns in Postgres:
* `Array(Numeric())` columns in SQLite now return `Decimal` values instead of floats (thanks to @b84330808 for the fix).
* Fixed a bug with auto migrations when adding or dropping a column which uses `db_column_name` (thanks to @atkei for this).

* Fixed reverse migrations on SQLite - they tried dropping tables using `CASCADE`, which SQLite doesn't support (thanks to @juneja-varun for this).
* Improved the contribution docs, including a Docker Compose file for easily running the test databases, and added a fixtures example to the docs (thanks to @mlbiche for this).

- support Antalya `metadata_type=cas` disks with `use_embedded_backup_restore: true`, `create_remote` no longer fails with `disk "cas" ... is not exists locally` and `restore_remote` no longer fails with `unsupported <metadata_type>cas</metadata_type>`, without embedded mode a table on a CAS disk fails with an explicit error, because `FREEZE` on CAS leaves no local files to hardlink, fix [#1562](https://github.com/Altinity/clickhouse-backup/issues/1562)
- `restore` and `restore_remote` no longer drop and re

- add `azblob.chunk_size` (env `AZBLOB_CHUNK_SIZE`, default `0`), a fixed upload block size used when `ceil(file size / chunk_size) <= max_parts_count`, clamped to [2MiB, 4000MiB], `0` keeps the automatic `file size / max_parts_count` clamped to [2MiB, 10MiB], brings back the explicit size removed together with `AZBLOB_BUFFER_SIZE` in v2.6.6, fix [#1142](https://github.com/Altinity/clickhouse-backup/issues/1142)
- back up and restore Kafka offsets of Kafka engine tables with `kafka_keeper_path` / `kafka_rep

This release brings new features (Bitmaps), API updates, the new database format, bug fixes and performance improvements.
- To trigger an action in the background cleaner thread just before database GC, `Environment.executeBeforeGc(Runnable action)` added.
## The new database format
As of 2.0.1, Patricia trees (backend trees for all stores created with key prefixing, i.e. with either StoreConfig.WITHOUT_DUPLICATES_WITH_PREFIXING or StoreConfig.WITH_DUPLICATES_WITH_PREFIXING) can be stored using the new form
This release brings bug fixes and performance improvements related to database ciphering and memory usage control.

This release brings bug fixes and minor performance improvements related to Entity Stores.

## API clarification.

Starting from version 1.3.124, `EntityStore.close()` doesn't close underlying explicitly created `Environment`. Prior to 1.3.124, this contract was undefined.
